sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the equipment inspection checklist (P1) which 
must be performed on a monthly bases as 
indicated by M1 in the title block

The technical specification of the 
CB Rated voltage is 17.5 kv - 50 HZ, rated current 8000A, rated short time current (4 sec) 74 K.A

The first draft is initiated by eng. Ragab 
Mohamed Aly ,reviewed by eng. Gamal Hassan Mohamed Hammad,
accepted by eng. Badr Ibrahem Abdel Gawad 
general director, and approved by eng. Abdel Karem Abu Zied Ismaiel; Head Sector 
of High Dam Hydraulic Power Station, Hyd.EPCo.

This document 
is certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem MPIS Hyd.EPCo.
Safety Precautions

items:
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintanance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety equipment as helmet, shoes breathing mask, safety glasses
Switch off the CB (B-1?G) 15.75 kv
Switch of the unit isolator (P-1G) 15.75 kv
Switch off the V.T of (M.G) for the unit

Switch off the automatics F 403 (D.C control of 
 the start / stop unit operation), 72D2 - 7 (D.C auto. for control of C.B, 
 unit filed, B.F protection) 14 AG (A.C auto. for control circuit of for the 
 unit disconnector Switch on the earths for M.G (Z - 1G), C.B 
 15.75 (Z - 1B)

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: Portable air blower
Using rag, cloth for cleaning

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Clean C.B from dust and 
dirt

Perform visual inspection 
for the unit C.B

Drain the air storage tank 
to remove water build - up

Check and clean of the 
compressor system and observe for leaks

Check the function of 
heaters

Check and clean the 
compressor motor system

Check the setting of 
pressures switches

Check the tightness of the 
terminal connections

Check the tight andsealed 
of C.B

Record the pressure (air, 
SF6 gas) for the C.B

Record numbers of close / 
open the C.B

Record numbers of 
operation hours of compressor

Check the function of the 
cabinet components by operating the C.B
